mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_comment ( content, user_nickname, created_at, updated_at, level, path, child_count, plan_post_no, user_no, parent_no ) VALUES ( #{content}, #{userNickname}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{level}, #{path}, #{childCount}, #{planPostNo}, #{userNo}, #{parentNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT no, content, user_nickname AS userNickname, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, level, path, child_count AS childCount, plan_post_no AS planPostNo, user_no AS userNo, parent_no AS parentNo FROM plan_comment WHERE no = #{commentNo}

SELECT no, content, user_nickname AS userNickname, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, level, path, child_count AS childCount, plan_post_no AS planPostNo, user_no AS userNo, parent_no AS parentNo FROM plan_comment WHERE plan_post_no = #{postNo} ORDER BY path LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
